title.narrative: Stöd till demokratiska institutioner i MENA
Support to democratic institutions in MENA

description.narrative:
Programmet syftar till att stärka inkluderande och demokratiska valprocesser i MENA-regionen genom att stödja regionala plattformar, kapacitetsstärka valinstitutioner och främja meningsfullt deltagande av kvinnor, ungdomar och marginaliserade grupper.
Programmet är organiserat kring följande målområnden: Målområde 1: Ökad inkludering, effektivitet och hållbarhet hos regionala valinstitutioner. Detta område fokuserar på att stärka regionala institutioner och plattformar för att stödja nationella valprocesser genom inkludering, transparens och ansvarstagande valsystem. Målområde 2: stärkt valintegritet, information och ansvarsskyldighet. Detta målområde fokuserar på att stärka valintegriteten genom ett människorättsbaserat tillvägagångssätt, digital informationshantering och evidensbaserat påverkansarbete. Målområde 3: Ökat inkluderat deltagande i valprocesser och demokratisk dialog. Detta målområde främjar inkluderande politiskt deltagande för kvinnor, ungdomar och personer med funktionsvariationer.

The program aims to strengthen inclusive and democratic electoral processes in the MENA region by supporting regional platforms, enhancing the capacity of electoral institutions, and promoting meaningful participation of women, youth, and marginalized groups.
The program is organised around the following outputs: Output 1: Increased Inclusiveness, Effectiveness, and Sustainability of Regional Electoral Institutions. This output aims to strengthen regional institutions and platforms to support national electoral processes by promoting inclusive, transparent, and accountable electoral systems. Sub-output 1.1 focuses on enhancing electoral standards and processes by engaging regional partners to define best practices, address emerging challenges like AI and digital misinformation, and foster collaboration. Sub-output 1.2 works to improve the effectiveness and sustainability of regional platforms by expanding stakeholder engagement, building capacity, and facilitating CSO involvement. Sub-output 1.3 ensures regional achievements translate into national impact through targeted support, monitoring frameworks, and capacity building initiatives that align national efforts with regional standards and foster ownership and sustainability.
Output 2: Strengthened Electoral Integrity, Information, and Accountability. This output focuses on reinforcing electoral integrity through a human rights based approach, digital information management, and evidence based advocacy. Sub-output 2.1 supports stakeholders in monitoring electoral rights violations using a standardized methodology, promoting human rights across institutions, and integrating findings into national and international reporting. Sub-output 2.2 addresses digital threats by equipping electoral bodies with tools to combat misinformation, hate speech, and online violence, while promoting ethical AI use and regulatory frameworks. Sub-output 2.3 enhances research and data collection by supporting institutions and CSOs in gathering and analyzing electoral data, fostering academic partnerships, and promoting knowledge sharing.
Output 3: Enhanced Inclusive Participation in Electoral Processes and Democratic Dialogue. This output promotes inclusive political participation for women, youth, and persons with disabilities, aligning with the UN’s “Leave No One Behind” principle and relevant SDGs. Sub-output 3.1 advances women’s political participation through support to the Arab Network for Women in Elections, promoting gender mainstreaming in EMBs, and fostering civil society engagement and knowledge exchange. Sub-output 3.2 strengthens youth engagement by supporting the Arab Network for Youth, facilitating regional forums, building partnerships, and promoting datadriven decision making through a youth participation dashboard. Sub-output 3.3 focuses on the inclusion of persons with disabilities by researching participation data, promoting accessible electoral practices, and facilitating dialogue on inclusive policies and standards with regional institutions and CSOs.

The aim of the ASPIRE initiative (The Arab States Partnership for Inclusive Rights in Elections) is to support and strengthen electoral processes in the Arab States through a rights-based approach. The initiative seeks to enhance the integrity, transparency, and inclusiveness of electoral systems, promote greater political participation, and ensure sustainable electoral reforms. By focusing on these goals, the ASPIRE initiative aims to contribute to the development of democratic governance and the protection of electoral rights in the region.
The program is orgnized around the following outputs:
Output 1: More Inclusive, Effective, and Sustainable Regional Electoral Institutions This output focuses on strengthening regional platforms to support national electoral systems. It enhances electoral standards and addresses emerging challenges such as AI and misinformation. It also builds the capacity and sustainability of regional bodies like ArabEMBs and LAS, while ensuring regional progress translates into national impact through targeted support and alignment with regional standards.
Output 2: Improved Electoral Integrity and Accountability This output promotes electoral integrity through a human rights-based approach, digital tools, and data-driven advocacy. It supports monitoring of electoral rights violations, equips institutions to counter digital threats using platforms like eMonitor, and enhances research and knowledge-sharing through data collection and academic partnerships.
Output 3: Greater Inclusive Participation in Elections This output encourages the political participation of women, youth, and persons with disabilities. It advances womens roles through networks and gender mainstreaming, strengthens youth engagement via forums and data tools, and promotes accessibility and inclusive policies for persons with disabilities through research and dialogue with regional institutions.
